=== every configured custom tool ===
$ oh a question
session tools: read, ls, find, grep, write, edit, subagent, task, bash, title, lookup, fetch, tide, weather

=== one custom tool turned off on the command line ===
$ oh -s tool.tide.enabled=false a question
session tools: read, ls, find, grep, write, edit, subagent, task, bash, title, lookup, fetch, weather
